turns.text: Can you pull up the asset write-off procedure in the branch documents? We have a machine that was written off, and I need to pin down how we get it off the books and what records we're supposed to keep here afterwards.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
Found it — `asset_writeoff_procedure.md` (finance note 11, revised October). Here is the shape of it.

**The route is eight steps, in order:**

1. Take the machine off the floor — no write-off while it is still in service.
2. Pull the register line — tag number, date tagged, original cost, net book value.
3. Fill out **DR-4**, one item per form: tag, those four figures, one-line reason, intended route (scrapped / sold / returned to supplier).
4. You sign it. If the net book value is above zero, the branch's finance contact has to countersign before it leaves the branch.
5. Send the DR-4 to Corporate Administration. Nothing leaves site until the approved form comes back.
6. Dispose only on the approved route — a different route voids the form and you start again.
7. Send the disposal certificate or sale receipt to Corporate Administration within **14 days** of the item leaving.
8. Corporate closes the register line on receipt of step 7; your branch copy gets marked closed the same day.

**What you keep afterwards:**

| Document | Retention |
|---|---|
| Approved DR-4 | 7 years from year end of disposal |
| Disposal certificate or sale receipt | 7 years, filed with the DR-4 |
| Branch copy of the closed register line | 7 years |
| The asset tag itself, removed and stapled to the branch copy | until the line is closed |

**One open question** the note itself flags: it does not say who the finance contact is for the countersignature (step 4) when the accountant on the rota is away.

Which machine are we writing off? That way I can pull the register line and get the DR-4 started.
